run_googletest_uninitialized_test: run the googletest uninitialized test to verify Google Test warns when not initialized properly
test_exit_code_and_output: test the TestExitCodeAndOutput function to verify a command's exit code and output contain InitGoogleTest
assert_condition: assert a condition is true using the Assert function which raises AssertionError on failure
